title: Networking Fundamentals — Failure Injection & Auto-Healing
purpose: Demonstrates automated packet failure recovery across SNAT port exhaustion and MTU blackholing, proving how Cloud NAT dynamic port allocation and PMTUD prevent silent connection drops.
routing_rationale: When a single zone encounters link saturation, Andromeda SDN and Cloud Load Balancing withdraw the degraded route in under 5 seconds, rerouting established TCP flows to healthy standby paths.

nodes.label: Active Backend VM (Zone A)
nodes.detail: Serving active production traffic in availability zone us-central1-a.

nodes.label: Health Check Probe
nodes.detail: Polls HTTP /healthz every 5s; 3 timeouts mark backend unhealthy.

nodes.label: Standby Backend VM (Zone B)
nodes.detail: Healthy warm standby instance in independent failure domain us-central1-b.

nodes.label: Andromeda Flow Router
nodes.detail: Dynamically updates routing table to bypass unhealthy instance.

steps.title: Steady-State Health Probing
steps.action: Cloud Health Check probes VM in Zone A with HTTP GET /healthz.
steps.why_traversal: Validates process responsiveness before routing incoming customer traffic.

steps.title: Probe Failure Detection
steps.action: After 3 missed probes, prober notifies Andromeda flow router of VM failure.
steps.why_traversal: Automated eviction prevents blackholing customer transactions on crashed instance.

steps.title: Dynamic Traffic Failover
steps.action: Andromeda rewires forwarding table to direct new TCP flows to Zone B.
steps.why_traversal: Sub-second route convergence preserves client SLAs during zonal outages.

steps.title: Healthy State Recovery
steps.action: Standby VM in Zone B assumes active traffic load with zero dropped sessions.
steps.why_traversal: Workloads distributed across independent failure domains maintain 99.99% availability.

scenarios.label: Zone A Fiber Blackhole
scenarios.root_cause: Physical optical fiber failure in Zone A datacenter cuts backend connectivity.
scenarios.diverted_path: Traffic is immediately shifted to Zone B standby nodes; Zone A is quarantined.
scenarios.blast_radius: Only uncommitted in-flight packets in Zone A require client retry.
scenarios.recovery: Automated regional MIG pre-scales Zone B capacity to absorb 100% diverted traffic.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
